shortDescription: Plate-loaded hip extension on a supported 45-degree machine, targeting the glutes and hamstrings.
descriptionHtml:
A supported, plate-loaded hip hinge on a dual 45-degree hip-extension machine. Foot-platform selection changes the emphasis between the glutes and hamstrings.

The demonstration shows the bent-knee, upper-foot-support setup. Adjust the machine to fit your body and follow its setup instructions.
instructions: Adjust the hip pad and starting handle to your height. Position the pad against your upper thighs so you can hinge freely at the hips.
Choose the machine's foot supports for your intended variation and plant both feet securely. The demonstration uses the upper supports with bent knees.
Hold the machine handles, brace your trunk, and keep your head in line with your spine.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips through a comfortable range, keeping your feet planted and your thighs supported.
Contract your glutes to extend your hips and return to alignment with your thighs. Keep the movement controlled and stop before arching your lower back.
Return the lever to its supported starting position before releasing the handles or stepping off.
notes: Log added plate weight consistently; unloaded lever resistance varies by machine. Muscle factors are app defaults, not measured activation. The generated demonstration is an illustrative draft with a limited range of motion.
